item.title: Invivoscribe® Launches LeukoStrat® KMT2A + MRD Assay to Advance High-Sensitivity Leukemia Testing in Clinical Trials and Patient Management Worldwide
item.description: SAN DIEGO — Invivoscribe, a leader in precision medicine and measurable residual disease (MRD) testing, today announced the addition of the LeukoStrat® KMT2A + MRD Assay and Software to its industry-leading oncology portfolio. item.title: ECB to Hold Rates Steady Despite Global Strains: Decision Guide
item.description: The European Central Bank is set to hold interest rates steady for a fifth meeting, judging that the latest bout of global tensions and euro strength haven’t thrown the economy off course yet.

item.title: Malaysia Sees Further Upside for Ringgit, 2026 Growth Forecast
item.description: The Malaysian ringgit, Asia’s top performing currency in the past year, still has potential to gain as the economy continues to perform strongly, Second Finance Minister Amir Hamzah Azizan said, indicating that growth forecasts may be revised higher.

item.title: China Trader Who Made $3 Billion on Gold Bets Big Against Silver
item.description: A billionaire Chinese trader who made his name riding gold’s record-breaking rally has turned his sights to silver’s breakneck surge, with a bet on the metal’s collapse now worth almost $300 million.

item.title: Sasol Profit Plunges on Oil-Price Drop, $483 Million Writedown
item.description: Sasol Ltd.’s 7.8 billion-rand ($483 million) writedown in parts of its South African and Mozambican businesses, together with a decline in oil and chemical prices, triggered a drop of as much as 99% in half-year profit.
